headline: NITDA Survey Shows 59% of Nigerian Financial Institutions Ready for Data Rule
summary: A survey by NITDA revealed that only 59% of banks and fintechs in Nigeria are ready to meet the Central Bank's January deadline to host all payment data locally.
why: Data localization mandates require significant IT infrastructure upgrades and compliance expenditures for financial institutions operating in regulated markets.

impacts.name: Financial Services
impacts.why: Compliance deadlines for local data storage impose mandatory IT capital expenditures across the banking and fintech sector.
